summary: Atlas H3-developer with an audio reference lip-syncs well in the first 4 s, where its own audio reproduces the slice: mouth opens on syllables and eyes stay on the lens, though the mouth did not fully close in the 2.26-2.57 pause. After about 4.2 s the model drifts into its own garbled words and the mouth follows those, not the slice; it also keeps talking 8.7-9.9 s after the slice ends. Identity, background and teeth are stable, but a hand appears at 0.1-0.5 s. Verdict PARTIAL: reliable only for roughly 4 s sentences, so slices should be kept to about 4 s or shorter, with the first 0.6 s trimmed. Review was from contact sheets only (4 fps), not mouth crops.
